# transform as complete outer bounding rectangle perimeter only
code='''def transform(grid):
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    pts=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v not in (7,)]
    color=next(grid[r][c] for r,c in pts)
    r0=min(r for r,c in pts); r1=max(r for r,c in pts)
    c0=min(c for r,c in pts); c1=max(c for r,c in pts)
    for c in range(c0,c1+1):
        if grid[r0][c]==7: out[r0][c]=2
        if grid[r1][c]==7: out[r1][c]=2
    for r in range(r0,r1+1):
        if grid[r][c0]==7: out[r][c0]=2
        if grid[r][c1]==7: out[r][c1]=2
    return out
'''
open(p,'w').write(code)
exec(code)
out=transform(grid)
